# TheDigitalWork

> TheDigitalWork is a digital agency based in Agra, India. It builds custom websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps, AI chatbots and WhatsApp automation, and runs digital marketing for businesses in India and worldwide.

## Services

- Website Development: fast, mobile-first business websites designed to convert visitors into enquiries and sales.
- E-commerce Development: online stores with product catalogues, secure payments and order management, including worldwide delivery setups.
- AI Chatbots & Automation: AI chatbots and WhatsApp automation that answer customer queries instantly and capture leads around the clock.
- Mobile App Development: Android and iOS apps, including SaaS products with memberships, attendance and payment tracking.
- Digital Marketing & Growth: Google Ads, social media marketing and SEO focused on measurable business growth.

## Selected Work

- [WOLHomes](https://wolhomes.com/): luxury rugs and crafts e-commerce store with worldwide delivery; owner Ahmed Hussen.
- [Raven Oracle](https://ravenoracle.xyz/): NFT raffle platform with transparent entries and recorded winners; owner Sazid Malik.
- [NonVegOnWheel](https://nonvegonwheel.in/): online food-ordering website for fresh meat and ready-to-cook products; owner Ashish Kumar.
- [Gym Manager App](https://gym-chi-swart-63.vercel.app): gym management SaaS with memberships, QR attendance and fee tracking.
- [Ayesha's](https://ayashas-vanity.vercel.app): beauty and makeup studio website with gallery and WhatsApp booking.
- [Vision Style](https://optical-eosin.vercel.app/): online eyewear store with eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses and virtual try-on.
- [Zaika House](https://restaurant-jet-xi-79.vercel.app/): pure-veg restaurant website with online menu, cart and table booking.

Full portfolio: https://thedigitalwork.in/portfolio.html
